newsitem.title: UK: RTZ Utah copper workers on strike.
newsitem.headline: RTZ Utah copper workers on strike.

text.p: Mining conglomerate RTZ Corp plc said on Thursday that unionised workers at its Kennecott copper smelter in Utah went on strike as of Wednesday.
But head of public affairs John Hughes said that production was not affected at the 310,000 short tons per year plant.
"Kennecott was informed by its unionised workers yesterday that the union workforce was on strike," Hughes told Reuters.
Asked if the firm was putting into action a plan to use management employees to keep the operation running, Hughes responded, "That is my understanding and they are continuing to produce copper."

About 1,800 unionised workers are employed at the copper smelter and have working without a contract since September 30. On Wednesday, an official of RTZ unit Kennecott Corp in Salt Lake City said operations would have to be curtailed in the event of a strike.
Three months copper prices on the London Metal Exchange were up around $20 a tonne from their overnight close of $1,900.
